questions.question: Evaluate $\displaystyle \int_{0}^{1}\frac{dx}{1+x^{2}}$ by Simpson's $\tfrac{1}{3}$ rule using the ordinates at $x=0,\;0.25,\;0.5,\;0.75,\;1$ (so $h=0.25$). Hence deduce the value of $\pi$ to four decimal places.
questions.knowledgeNote: Simpson's $\tfrac13$ rule is $\frac{h}{3}[y_0+4(y_1+y_3)+2y_2+y_4]$ and needs an **even** number of sub-intervals.
